findings.title: A PoEAA Source with a wrong non-3-digit page passed
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: Source 'Fowler, *PoEAA*, see Repository (32); ISBN' and '... Repository (3220) and Unit of Work (184).' exited 0
findings.resolution: fixed (author): the gate compares every pattern token in a Source with ANY_PAGE; both inputs are regression tests and exit 1.

findings.title: A prefixed unknown name passed when more text followed
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: 'Fowler, *PoEAA*, Repositry (322) and Unit of Work (184).' exited 0 (lookahead rejected ' and')
findings.resolution: fixed (author): prefixedCitations reads the name as the word run right after the prefix, no trailing lookahead; regression test exits 1.

findings.title: The catalog's own spellings, lowercase names, and spaced pages escaped the check
findings.question: ownership
findings.resolution: fixed (author): registry aliases for MVC, DTO, Special Case; case-insensitive, space-or-hyphen matching; '( 322 )' and '(p. 322)' page forms; regression tests for each.

findings.title: Plan check held correct records and passed wrong ones
findings.question: boundary
findings.evidence: 'Model-View-Controller (330)', 'Null Object (496)', 'PR (415)' held; 'Unit of work (999)' etc. passed
findings.resolution: fixed (author): same alias and case matching; unknown names need a lowercase letter and a 3-digit page; nested list fields checked; regression tests. 'Repositry (3220)' stays uncaught, recorded as a limit in ADR-0106.

findings.title: Any 'ch. N' satisfied the PoEAA-source rule
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: 'Fowler, Patterns of Enterprise Application Architecture, ch. 42.' and 'Evans, DDD, ch. 5; Fowler ISBN 0-321-12742-0.' exited 0
findings.resolution: fixed (author): a chapter counts only through prefixedCitations with chapterOk, and the prefix accepts the full title; regression tests exit 1.

findings.title: Half install read as an old mirror; import trust boundary unrecorded
findings.question: dependency
findings.evidence: deleting only poeaa-registry.json returned not-assessed and passed
findings.resolution: fixed (author): not-assessed only when both files are missing, exactly one present is held (test); ADR-0106 records the in-process import trust boundary and that it does not defend a deliberately edited install.

findings.title: Outline placeholders filled in several passes
findings.question: error-handling
findings.evidence: row |<m>|y| ran as 'the value y and y'
findings.resolution: fixed (author): one-pass replace; regression test; scenario name keeps placeholders (datastore names the outline that way), recorded in ADR-0106.

minorNotes: Reviewer probed adversarial inputs with node against the module, the gate, and the plan check (scratchpad/wp2-review/adv.mjs, plan.mjs) and ran a mutation of the page-compare line: 9 tests failed on the first draft; after fixes 17 fail.

Fixes applied by the author after the review; not re-reviewed. After fixes: node --test of the four affected files 160/160; bdd-run 135 runs OK; check-bdd-executed 114 OK; bdd-index in sync; check:architecture 0; check_adr and claim-lint clean on ADR-0106.

Full npm test before fixes: 1136/1151 pass; the 5 failures were the untracked docs/research link file (known, local only) and 4 esk-init tests that fail only because always-on/ had uncommitted edits (esk-init refuses to install from a dirty always-on/; reproduced by hand; they pass on origin/main).
Reviewer noted (not findings): '(0322)' reads as 322 in a prefixed citation; arrays in the record were unchecked (now checked).
archGate: pass (npm run check:architecture exit 0 after fixes, run by author)
